title: Operation Sindoor | K.C. Venugopal moves privilege notice against Rajnath for ‘misleading’ Parliament
description: Congress general secretary K.C. Venugopal on Tuesday (June 30, 2026) moved a privilege notice against Defence Minister Rajnath Singh in the Lok Sabha, accusing him of misleading Parliament by stating during the Operation Sindoor debate last year that no Indian soldier had been killed.
